categories.main_business_segments: Data Image Corporation primarily engages in the design, manufacturing, and sales of touch-type LCD display modules and LCD display modules. Their products are mainly applied in maritime displays, industrial control displays, special vehicle displays, and medical displays. The company also offers customized solutions with features such as high brightness, high contrast, durability, waterproof, dustproof, shock resistance, anti-reflection, corrosion resistance, wide temperature range, and wide viewing angles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced TFT-LCD technology with capabilities in optical bonding, capacitive touch panels, and specialized coatings for durability and environmental resistance. They focus on outdoor ruggedized displays with high reliability for harsh environments, integrating hardware and software for intelligent edge computing solutions. Production includes full-process display module manufacturing with rigorous quality control, including aging tests, assembly, and optical enhancements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in niche, mission-critical sectors such as maritime navigation, industrial automation, special vehicles (e.g., snowmobiles, ATVs), medical equipment, and green energy applications like electric vehicle charging stations. The company serves both domestic and international markets, focusing on professional and industrial end-users requiring high-reliability and customized display solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taoyuan and offices in New Taipei City. Its sales markets are global, with significant revenue from Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company also collaborates with subsidiaries and partners in China (Suzhou) and the United States to support local manufacturing and customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Data Image Corporation operates in the midstream segment of the display industry supply chain as a display module integrator and solution provider. It sources key components like LCD panels, IC chips, backlight modules, and touch panels from multiple suppliers and provides value-added assembly, customization, and system integration services to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-value-added products, especially outdoor ruggedized displays with enhanced durability and high brightness. It invests in new technologies such as Mini/Micro LED, advanced touch solutions, and integrated system platforms combining hardware and AI-driven software. Strategic collaboration with group companies and partners aims to develop intelligent edge computing products and expand into new vertical markets like green energy and financial service terminals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of customized touch and LCD display modules. The company also derives income from system integration services and solution development for specialized industrial and professional applications. It maintains a diversified customer base to mitigate risks associated with demand fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other listed display module manufacturers such as Allion, Lingsu Technology, and Guanglian Technology. It differentiates itself by focusing on niche markets requiring rugged, high-reliability displays for maritime, industrial, special vehicle, and medical applications. Its strong R&D capabilities, customization, and system integration position it as a leading supplier in these specialized segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the fiscal year 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.42 billion, a 13% decrease from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to the parent company of NT$241 million. Despite short-term revenue decline due to global economic factors and inventory adjustments, the company maintains stable profitability and has increased capital through cash equity raises. It invests over 6% of revenue in R&D, supporting medium- to long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Data Image Corporation offers highly customized, ruggedized display modules with superior environmental resistance, suitable for mission-critical applications in harsh conditions. Its value proposition includes integrated hardware-software solutions, high product reliability, and strong customer collaboration for co-development. The company emphasizes quality, flexibility in small-batch production, and advanced technologies to meet diverse customer needs in specialized industrial markets.
